claim_text: On December 16, 2025, a grand jury in the District of Minnesota returned an indictment in United States v. Hassan Ahmed Hussein and Ahmed Abdirashid Mohamed, No. 0:25-cr-00479 (ECF 1), charging both defendants with Counts 1–5, wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. § 1343, through Pristine Health LLC. Each count is an alleged interstate email: Count 1, on or about April 27, 2023, from Hassan Hussein to AllCare Software; Count 2, on or about August 22, 2023, from Hassan Hussein to A. Hussein attaching paperwork for purported beneficiary Damien R.; Count 3, on or about September 18, 2023, email exchanges between Ahmed Mohamed and AllCare Software; Count 4, on or about October 31, 2024, from Ahmed Mohamed to Hassan Hussein attaching paperwork for purported beneficiary Haley G.; Count 5, on or about December 31, 2024, from Hassan Hussein to DHS regarding an emergency clients update. These are charging allegations, not adjudicated facts.
